newsitem.title: USA: DI Industries acquires Texas drilling rigs.
newsitem.headline: DI Industries acquires Texas drilling rigs.

text.p: DI Industries Inc said Monday it has acquired all of Mesa Drilling Inc 's South Texas operational assets in exchange for 5.5 million shares of DI Industries common stock.
The assets acquired include six diesel electric drilling rigs, three of which are currently operating in South Texas.
The other three rigs are currently stacked and are to be placed in DI's Gulf Coast division, serving to complement the company's existing fleet of 80 rigs.
Before the transaction, DI Industries had 117,730,734 shares of common stock outstanding.
